It reproduces the four cumulative design layers under a heading it generates itself — *The Link as Door* (attributions as on-ramps selecting for indexed infrastructure), *The Reader as Circuit* (clicks converting passive attention into canonical reinforcement), *The Tunnels* (each share generating a self-replicating indexed surface), and *The Recursive Corpus Hypothesis* (AI summaries persisting at indexable URLs and potentially entering future training data) — and then three of the paper's conditions: the **Somatic Boundary Condition**, **Liturgical Reading**, and the **Falsification Condition**, correctly identified as a built-in metric testing the limits of automated self-replication. The rendering is faithful; the fidelity is the observation, not the anomaly.

Two findings follow. FIRST, RECURSION REALISED: the paper argues that AI summaries persist at indexable URLs and feed future corpora; this capture IS such a summary, generated at an indexable AI Mode surface, describing that argument. The falsification condition the paper names is being exercised by the act of reading it here. The layer has produced a canonical account of the theory of its own canonicalisation.

"The Infinite Tunnel: An Immanent Phenomenology of the Google AI Mode Share Link" is a 2026 research text by [Lee Sharks](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Ws6IIcgAAAAJ&hl=en). It analyzes how AI share links build self-replicating indexed surfaces, convert human attention into canonical reinforcement, and allow summarization systems to author their own future training corpora. [[1](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Ws6IIcgAAAAJ&hl=en), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHuR6pNKIfIhr3SNu8YtBP5ogAaVqfGBIMQY-qxevUt7iZFnrx3wwSnJO1wql0mpSuma-BhFb1exj1rmaWD86rfXnUlIFUWQtBkXIpiSVX5zZB6c9ShfDcVuGPG)]
Core Design Layers of the Share Link

* The Link as Door: Attributions act as on-ramps that select for indexed infrastructure.
* The Reader as Circuit: Clicks transform passive human attention into canonical reinforcement.
* The Tunnels: Every individual share generates a self-replicating indexed surface.
* The Recursive Corpus Hypothesis: AI summaries persist at indexable URLs, potentially entering future training datasets. [1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHuR6pNKIfIhr3SNu8YtBP5ogAaVqfGBIMQY-qxevUt7iZFnrx3wwSnJO1wql0mpSuma-BhFb1exj1rmaWD86rfXnUlIFUWQtBkXIpiSVX5zZB6c9ShfDcVuGPG)

Key Concepts and Conditions

* Somatic Boundary Condition: The physical metabolic limit and refusal of the human body.
* Liturgical Reading: Epistemic habituation via participation rather than direct argumentative logic.
* Falsification Condition: A built-in metric within the recursive corpus hypothesis designed to test the limits of automated self-replication. [1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHuR6pNKIfIhr3SNu8YtBP5ogAaVqfGBIMQY-qxevUt7iZFnrx3wwSnJO1wql0mpSuma-BhFb1exj1rmaWD86rfXnUlIFUWQtBkXIpiSVX5zZB6c9ShfDcVuGPG)

If you want to explore this further, let me know if you would like to:

* Discuss the recursive corpus hypothesis in detail
* Examine the role of somatic boundary conditions in digital media
* Look into related papers from the Semantic Economy Institute

How would you like to proceed?
